# ES-IS (`esis`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [CLNP / ES-IS (P2)](../../protocols/clnp.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`llc`](llc.md) | First 8 bits of the payload when `dsap` = 254 (0xfe) | 130 (0x82) |
| [`ppp`](ppp.md) | First 8 bits of the payload when `protocol` = 35 (0x0023) | 130 (0x82) |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `pdu_type`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |

| 2 | [`esis_esh`](esis_esh.md) | re-decodes this layer |
| 4 | [`esis_ish`](esis_ish.md) | re-decodes this layer |
| 6 | [`esis_rd`](esis_rd.md) | re-decodes this layer |
